auth.notes: Bearer token is the Gemini API key. Google's documented OpenAI-compatibility layer accepts it as a standard Authorization: Bearer <key> header on this endpoint. Re-confirmed 2026-07-11 via Google's own cookbook (google-gemini/cookbook, Get_started_OpenAI_Compatibility.ipynb, fetched directly).

notes: Targets Google's documented OpenAI-compatible endpoint (generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai), not the native Gemini REST/SDK shape -- so it plugs into the same openai-compat adapter as Zhipu/Venice/xAI with no new translation code.

2026-07-11 pass: pricing upgraded from null/unconfirmed to FIRST-PARTY figures fetched directly (raw HTML) from Google's own pricing page -- see verification.pricing_note for the channel caveat. gemini-3.5-flash confirmed real and GA two independent first-party ways (priced line item on Google's pricing page; selectable id in Google's official cookbook notebook).

Capability flags (tools/vision) are cookbook-demonstrated: every id below appears in the official google-gemini/cookbook OpenAI-compatibility notebook's model picker, exercised there against tool-calling and image-input cells. Not exercised against the live API from this build environment.

context/max_output are intentionally omitted for every model: the widely-reported 1M/65K figures for the 2.5/3.x families were secondary-source-only this pass (ai.google.dev egress-blocked), so they read as unverified fail-closed rather than guessed.

No 'Gemini 3.5 Pro' exists on Google's own pricing page as of 2026-07-11 -- claims of one (2M context, 'Deep Think mode') trace only to SEO content farms and were rejected. gemini-3-pro-preview is likewise excluded: not a pricing line item, not in the cookbook; secondary sources claim it now aliases to gemini-3.1-pro-preview (unconfirmed first-party).

verification.pricing_note: CHANNEL CAVEAT: figures are from Google's Vertex/'Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform' pricing page (Global tier, standard, <=200K-context tier where tiering applies), because ai.google.dev -- the standalone Gemini Developer API pricing page for the endpoint this manifest actually targets -- was egress-blocked (403 at the CONNECT layer) for the whole session. Historically the two channels' pay-as-you-go list prices match, and third-party citations of ai.google.dev's displayed gemini-3.5-flash price matched these figures exactly ($1.50/$9.00). Marked high on that basis; re-check ai.google.dev from an unblocked network if the meter and a Google invoice ever disagree.
verification.capabilities_note: tools/vision flags come from each id's presence in Google's official OpenAI-compat cookbook notebook (tool-calling + image-input cells) -- first-party-adjacent, not live-API-exercised from this environment.

models.notes: Flagship 2.5 reasoning model. TIERED: $1.25/$10 per 1M applies to <=200K-token context; >200K bills $2.50/$15 (manifest carries the base tier; the meter does not yet tier by context -- same treatment as anthropic's dated intro pricing note). Non-global regions +10%.
Flat (not context-tiered) text/image/video input rate; audio input is priced separately ($1/1M) and is not modeled here.

Cross-corroborated by this repo's venice.json reselling the same model as gemini-3-5-flash at $1.55/$9.45 (~3-5% reseller markup over these native figures). Flat rate, not context-tiered.
